designPrinciple: Slow, quiet, predictable, serviceable and fail-safe rotation with a passive rotating field, positive service restraint, independent secondary retention and evidence-gated component selection.

authorityBoundaries.electricalBoundary: Powered kinetic equipment remains fixed-side where practical; passive targets may rotate. Any powered rotating device requires controlled rotary power/data review.

unknownPhysicalInputs.source: production mass map and balance test

primaryLoadPath: primary bearing rolling/race elements and bolted rings
secondaryRetentionPath: rotating capture flange / retained hub feature
driveTorquePath: positive belt or geared transmission under qualification
brakingPath: fixed-side spring-applied or otherwise positively acting brake under qualification
serviceLockPath: positive mechanical lock pin/bolt in double-shear style support or equivalent
prohibitedAccidentalLoadPaths: motor gearbox as primary vertical structural support

alternateStudyFamilies: large thin-section bearing only with supplier combined-load proof
multi-roller turntable only with demonstrated load sharing/alignment/noise
requirements: mounting flatness and bolt preload control
secondary retention independent enough to arrest primary support failure
selectionInputs: actual rotating mass and center of gravity

driveArchitecture.preferredStudy: fixed-side gearmotor with positive synchronous-belt/toothed-ring transmission, mechanically separate from the primary bearing load path
alternateStudies: central geared drive if demonstrably better
friction drive as non-preferred due slip/wear

normalOperation.softStart: required; acceleration limit TBD by physical pendulum tests
normalOperation.normalStop: controlled deceleration to verified zero speed before holding state

directionReversal.requirement: if later enabled, stop to verified zero, wait test-derived settling dwell, then soft-start opposite direction; never command instantaneous reversal

requirements: lock disengaged for jog and re-engaged before access

brakingArchitecture.parkingHolding: fixed-side normally-engaged mechanical brake preferred study; rating unselected
brakingArchitecture.faultStop: controlled stop when drive/feedback trustworthy, otherwise remove propulsion and apply qualified mechanical brake per final risk assessment
brakingArchitecture.emergencyStop: final stop behavior/category depends on released risk assessment; no SIL/PL/category claim here
brakingArchitecture.powerLossStop: spring-applied or equivalent power-off brake preferred study; stopping and pendulum response require physical validation
brakingArchitecture.serviceRestraint: motor brake is never the sole service restraint; positive mechanical service lock is mandatory
requirements: separate stopping, holding and service restraint
do not assume gearbox self-locking is a safe service hold

serviceLock.concept: fixed-frame positive lock pin/bolt engages a dedicated rotating receiver ring/bracket at defined service index positions; lock loads bypass precision bearing rolling elements and motor brake
serviceLock.engagedState: verified zero speed, aligned index, captive lock fully engaged and mechanically retained
requirements: cannot depend on software or motor torque
technician can verify full engagement directly
transfers service loads to fixed structural frame
fixed sensor may supplement but not replace mechanical verification
final controls inhibit run while engaged
validation: bidirectional static proof after load defined

secondaryRetention.concept: independent annular catch/capture structure around the primary bearing/hub; a rotating capture flange runs with normal clearance inside/below fixed catch sectors and engages only after abnormal separation
secondaryRetention.normalLoadSharingIntent: non-load-sharing; no routine contact in normal operation
secondaryRetention.failureEngagement: multiple circumferential catch sectors arrest abnormal axial fall/overturning into the fixed structural frame after primary support separation
requirements: valid structural path to fixed frame/site interfaces
independence from relevant primary failure modes
continuous rotation without winding flexible tethers
rating from approved abnormal load case
proof test and controlled simulated engagement
secondaryRetention.postEngagement: fixture out of service until full inspection/disposition

balanceAndTrim.concept: indexed trim-mass stations on rotating structural carrier/hub correct first-moment imbalance without moving controlled cable-exit coordinates
requirements: record installed suspended-assembly mass by element ID where available
consume controlled S/M/L mass distributions from Issue #9
positively locked and secondarily captured trim masses
field re-trim does not alter controlled geometry
procedure: record mass map and calculate first moments
balanceAndTrim.numericTrimRangeStatus: TBD after production mass variation is measured

feedbackArchitecture.principle: keep powered sensing electronics fixed-side and place only passive scale/targets/markers on the rotating hub/carrier
preferredStudies: fixed non-contact readhead plus passive rotary scale/ring
fixed proximity/magnetic sensors plus passive multi-target ring and independent index
requirements: derive resolution/target count from fault-detection latency at 0.08 rpm
distinct index where service alignment needed
no powered rotating encoder electronics without formal rotary power/data architecture change
feedback disagreement creates defined fault state

failedRestart: command but no movement in test-derived window

requirements: thresholds from commissioning/dynamic tests and manufacturer evidence
software fault detection never substitutes for secondary mechanical retention
fault logs capture command, feedback, load estimate and stop outcome where available

powerLoss.behavior: remove propulsion command; qualified power-off brake/holding function acts; verify zero speed after controls return
powerLoss.note: if brake application excites unsafe pendulum motion, evaluate controlled energy reserve/ride-through formally rather than weakening holding

restartSequence: do not auto-resume previous motion command
reduced-risk low-speed verification move where procedure requires

rules: Blender/kinematic animation is not dynamic evidence
record repeatability and worst credible transient

clearanceValidation.staticReviewTooling: controlled engineering schedule plus Three.js/three-mesh-bvh may screen static geometry
clearanceValidation.dynamicRequirement: final authority requires physical swept-motion evidence including transients, mass variation, imbalance and longest/shortest lines
clearanceValidation.acceptanceMarginsStatus: TBD from physical tests and tolerances

stages.name: representative small cluster
stages.purpose: neighbor interaction and local clearance with mixed S/M/L

stages.name: full 240-element factory pre-hang
stages.purpose: product-level dynamic clearance, balance, noise, stop, lock, retention, fault and endurance evidence

faultCases: commanded stall / resisted motion on rig
dynamicTestProgram.releaseRule: do not progress directly from CAD/visualization to occupied-space installation; close applicable findings before each higher-risk stage

rules: no planned replacement requires destructive canopy removal
intervals derive from exact manufacturer instructions plus endurance evidence
retention engagement/unexplained contact triggers out-of-service inspection
rotating-component replacement triggers balance/clearance review as applicable

rotatingMassAndInertia.equationReference: I_z = sum(m_i * r_i^2 + I_i,local) + I_carrier + I_rotating_drive_parts; use SI units and measured/controlled mass properties

bearingLoads.rule: supplier selection uses combined approved load cases and mounting conditions; catalog maxima are not product design loads

driveTorque.equationReference: T_drive,required = reserve * ((I_eq * alpha) + T_bearing + T_drag + T_imbalance + T_other), evaluated by signed load case; do not populate reserve or torques before evidence exists

braking.rule: normal, fault, emergency and power-loss cases are separate

balanceTrim.equationReference: M_x = sum(m_i*x_i); M_y = sum(m_i*y_i); verify correction by physical low-speed test

rules: record exact manufacturer/family/variant when using published data
do not convert catalog maximum load into VX4800 design load
do not mix incompatible variant ratings
component certification does not certify VX4800
